correctness.rationale: Independent enumeration gives 32 perfect matchings and face vector (20,142,392,418,192,32). Independent replay validates all 526 free-face pairs; the remaining complex is connected with face vector (18,66,60). Contracting the 17-edge tree gives 49 generators; each of the 49 recorded relators kills exactly one generator after the previous eliminations, proving trivial fundamental group over the integers, not just after abelianization. The residual complex is two-dimensional, so its H2 is free, of rank 11 by Euler characteristic 12. Hurewicz realizes the basis and the simply connected homology Whitehead theorem gives the claimed wedge equivalence. Low-dimensional reduced homology excludes pure shellability.
residual_risks: This verifies a single graph, not a family or an equivariant homotopy type.

value.rationale: This is a natural first boundary comparison with the even-width open-strip theorem: closing the longitudinal direction at four columns produces a genuinely different homotopy dimension and a precise multiplicity, not just an agreement of Euler characteristics. The full integral classification is useful as a benchmark for attempts to extend open-strip results to periodic strips or cubical boxes.
